title: The Closed Gate and the Service of the Priests
description: Ezekiel sees that the east gate of the sanctuary is shut because the Lord has entered through it; only the prince may sit there and eat bread before the Lord. The glory of the Lord fills the temple, and God gives regulations for the lower service of the unfaithful Levites and the priestly service of the faithful sons of Zadok—their linen garments, marriage, purity, teaching, and inheritance, where the Lord himself is their possession [ref:Ezekiel 44:1-31|Ezekiel 44:1-31].
